title: x5chain integration with EDHOC credential
description: Extend the EDHOC responder (python/src/lichen/coap/resources/edhoc.py) to support X.509 certificate credentials in addition to raw public keys. RFC 9528 Methods 0 and 2 allow cert-based authentication. When a node presents an x5chain during EDHOC, the responder validates the chain against the trust store and establishes the OSCORE context with CA-backed identity. Python impl first. Depends on trust store CoAP resource (for CA root lookup) and cert profile (for cert validation).
